points.title: Tools provided
points.body: Chisels, planes and saws, sharpened every evening.

points.title: Local timber
points.body: Larch and oak from woods along the estuary.

points.title: Small groups
points.body: Six to a bench, so nobody waits for help.

points.title: Safety first
points.body: Gloves, glasses and a first aider in every shed.

props.heading: On the workshop floor.
props.headingRest: Every joint cut by hand, with a mentor beside you.

content.text: Each morning starts with a short demonstration at the bench. Then you build your own version,
one mentor for every six students
